whatis.intro: Food markup is what you add to the cost of food product to set its selling price. For a distributor that cuts, trims or portions product, that cost has to sit on the pounds that sell. Trim is paid for but does not sell at the cut's price.

cards.title: Only the pounds you can bill
cards.body: The pounds that leave on an invoice. A 40 lb case at an 85% yield gives 34 lb, and the full $48.00 has to come back from those 34.
cards.alt: Plus sign, for the usable pounds in a case

cards.title: Saw hours and packaging stay outside
cards.body: Cutting labor and packaging. The $48.00 landed cost covers freight and handling in, not the hours on the saw, so the margin has to pay for them.
cards.alt: Minus sign, for cutting labor outside the case cost

cards.title: Catch-weight cases
cards.body: Catch-weight items are billed by the pound, so a light case also costs less. The price per usable lb holds whatever a case weighs, as long as the yield holds.
cards.alt: Light bulb, for cases billed by the pound

look.h2: Three checks on yield before you price a cut
look.intro: Yield moves this price the most, and it is the input most often guessed. Pin down these three before a rep quotes the cut.

steps.title: The case weight that arrives
steps.body: If the supplier bills by the case, weigh what comes off the truck. A 40 lb case that weighs in light costs more per pound than the label says.

steps.title: Weight lost before it ships
steps.body: Product gives up liquid in the cooler and on the saw. Measure usable weight as it leaves, not right after cutting, or the yield reads high.

steps.title: Trim you sell, taken off the cost
steps.body: If trim goes out as ground product or to a renderer, take what it earns off the $48.00. Skip that and the cut carries a cost the trim already pays back.

vos.h2: Where VOS fits around the cut room
vos.h3: A confirmed order to cut against
vos.body: VOS does not price cut product or calculate yield. It works on the order: customers order by voice in the VOS app, review each line, and the order reaches you confirmed and timestamped.
bullets: Each app order carries a number, so who ordered what is on record
Delivered by email, EDI or API, in the format you use
Most distributors are live in 24 to 48 hours
